label: POC Onboarding: CIT Test from Order
mcp_tool_description: Turn a finished blueprint order (ORD- id, status SUCCESS, FAILURE or WARNING) into a Continuous Infrastructure Testing test, the same as the order page's Add to CIT action: CloudBolt replays the order on each test run and compares the result with the original status (test plan 4.2.4). An order that is already a test is reported, not duplicated. Run the test afterwards with run_cit_tests; each run provisions and decommissions a server. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
